nodes.label: UI Stand Icon (standing humanoid figure)
nodes.description: Flat monochrome white/near-white glyph of a front-facing standing human figure (circular head, blocky torso, two legs), restroom-pictogram style. Depicts the stand / stop-moving (idle stance) player action. Belongs to the Thaira UI control system (action or state toggle button); same minimal solid-fill silhouette style as the other ui_* glyphs.
